operator_scope: Fresh durable unified runtime and environment; change entry points; preserve all durable workspace state. Everyone uses a unified surface.
direct_controller_reason: Runtime selection, service lifecycle and cutover are cross-workstream integration responsibilities. Operator explicitly authorized maintenance outside PA1 task claims.
delegation: Configured researcher/scout/implementer/reviewer; no local coding workers
state_policy: No authority reset, import, restore or hand editing; preserve source and state in place; private backup before cutover.
entrypoint_policy: One stable current release selector used by CLI, Codex stdio and unified HTTP service. Preserve existing profile authorization boundaries.
